apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Physical iPhone test confirms no blocks with direct Metal 4 presentation, bridge off, active MetalFX and HEVC 10-bit 4:4:4 HDR. Registers CAMetalLayer residency with both GPU queues as in Apple’s sample. Release build, 334 automated tests and 168 Mac GPU checks pass. Consistent 120 FPS, a separate decoder recovery event and iPad behavior remain unverified/unresolved. Diagnostic bridge fallback retained; prior input/navigation fixes remain and frame generation is absent. Unsigned build for installer signing.
